responsibility: This file implements the PRU-specific source pragmas, currently the CTABLE_ENTRY pragma used by C-family front ends. It parses pragma arguments, validates CTABLE slot numbers and constant base addresses, emits diagnostics for malformed, conflicting, or suspicious entries, and records successful mappings into the global pru_ctable table so later PRU address-selection and instruction generation can use LBCO/SBCO constant-table addressing.
